layer_1_style.description: High-poly 3D animation style, cinematic CGI, smooth clay textures, soft studio lighting, tactile 'handmade' feel.

layer_3_action.subject: Ankylosaurid tail club morphology
features: A large, heavy clay tail club made of two fused hemispherical bony masses
The club has a weathered, stone-like clay texture with realistic cracks and pockmarks
The tail leading up to the club is armored with sharp, triangular clay spikes (osteoderms)
The clay is colored in shades of dark charcoal and stony grey with hints of brown earth tones
The tail is held in a dynamic, mid-swing pose to showcase its weight and power
layer_3_action.action: A cinematic side-view shot of the clay tail club. The lighting is dramatic, highlighting the heavy textures and the lethal-looking spikes on a dark, neutral studio background. This serves as a 'Tail Club' morphology icon. No text.
